title: Pivotality and boundary edges
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $e\in\{\pm1\}^n$ satisfy $e_i=+1$. For either sign $\sigma\in\{\pm1\}$, form $x$ by replacing coordinate $i$ of $e$ with $\sigma$. For any Boolean function $f$, $f$ is pivotal at $x$ in coordinate $i$ if and only if $f(e)$ differs from its value at the input obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ of $e$.
hypotheses_covered: Sign vector e with coordinate i equal to +1
Boolean function f on the n-dimensional sign cube
Input is the vector obtained by setting coordinate i of e to σ
